moments.title: UK Singles Chart: Sienna Spiro holds No.1, All-Female Top 6
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains at number one for a third week on the Official UK Singles Chart, which also features an all-female top six for the first time since 2023.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro makes it three weeks at Number 1 with 'Great Expectation'! Who's loving this track on the UK Singles Chart right now?

angles.name: Female Power
angles.copy: History made on the UK Singles Chart! For the first time in three years, the entire Top 6 is held by female artists. Who are your faves?

angles.name: Youthful Success
angles.copy: At just 20, Sienna Spiro is the youngest British female to score a Number 1 in 12 years. Big things ahead!
